hypothesis: Verify whether create_or_exchange_session allows legitimate non-rotated (db_ver == 1) upgraded devices holding valid Proof-of-Possession JWTs signed by LEGACY_SESSION_SECRET_KEY / PREVIOUS_SESSION_SECRET_KEY to silently migrate to a current-secret JWT while strictly rejecting rotated sessions (db_ver > 1 and token_ver < db_ver) and never allowing unauthenticated expected_user_id == clean_uid claims to bypass PoP.

Verify whether get_verified_session_with_grace supports optional LEGACY_SESSION_SECRET_KEY / PREVIOUS_SESSION_SECRET_KEY decoding alongside current SESSION_SECRET_KEY within the 90-day grace window for /api/auth/credential and /api/auth/rotate, while preserving strict iss/type/UUID validation and downstream credential_version revocation checks.

Verify whether GET /api/cloudinary-test gates execution in production environments and avoids returning apiSecretLength, apiSecretFirst4, apiSecretLast4, and unauthenticated testSignature generation when deployed on public production hosts.

Verify whether lastExchangeFailedAt (10s window) and lastDismissedAt (5s window) allow 15-second SWR polling or concurrent API retries to trigger repeated POST /api/auth/session 401 failures and re-open SessionReauthModal seconds after a user clicks dismiss, instead of latching failed credential fingerprints and preserving in-memory modal dismissal until reload or explicit re-anchor.

Verify whether ensureValidSession sends expected_user_id when an established UUID exists, latches exact failed exchange credential fingerprints on 401 (not 5xx/network failures), resets failure/dismiss latches on visitor purge or reanchor/reset, and retains server 401 detail via getLastAuthExchangeError() so callers do not overwrite specific errors.

Verify whether apiFetch allows 1-time silent session refresh on 401 for /api/poi/* endpoints without purging local tokens or popping SessionReauthModal when remote D1 rejects a non-prod session, and preserves getLastAuthExchangeError() detail on non-POI reauth prompts.

Verify whether fetcherWithUserId preserves getLastAuthExchangeError() detail when triggering triggerReauthPrompt after a failed 401 re-exchange rather than overwriting specific server details with a static fallback string.

Verify whether background /api/chat/summarize requests obtain a valid session token via ensureValidSession() when getCachedToken() is null and perform a 1-time non-Gemini 401 refresh and retry matching sse-parser.ts.
